text:
maria_docs: Heads-up: adding a short docs blurb for Nordics availability & residency. Need a tiny CLI + Node SDK snippet, plus a one-line legal caveat about routing. Anyone free to pair on wording?

juan_l10n: I can draft the snippets. Quick question: should we use `X-Region` or `X-Redwood-Region`?

sam_platform: Use `X-Region` for now. Router normalizes headers to lowercase and expects `x-region`. We'll note that in the docs.

juan_l10n: Drafted — posting examples here before I open a PR: 

```bash
# CLI example
curl -sS https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "X-Region: nordics" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"Hi from the Nordics"}'
```

```js
// Node SDK example (pseudo)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-1-small',
  prompt: 'Hi from the Nordics',
  headers: { 'X-Region': 'nordics' }
});
// detect if we were routed elsewhere
if (res.headers && res.headers['x-region-fallback']) {
  console.warn('Routed to fallback region:', res.headers['x-region-fallback']);
}
```

emma_legal: Suggested legal blurb: "Requests targeted at the Nordics region are processed within EU/EEA boundaries when possible; refer to your contract for definitive residency guarantees." Keep it non-committal.

maria_docs: Good. Could add a short second sentence about fallbacks: something like "If regional capacity is constrained, requests may fall back to compatible EU regions; we expose fallback routing in response headers and the Console."

sam_platform: We'll return `x-region-fallback` header when fallback occurs. Also add a note that header values are normalized to lowercase.

juan_l10n: Updated the draft with the legal lines and a tiny code snippet that checks `x-region-fallback`. Planning to open PR with CLI + SDK example + two-line note.

juan_l10n: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1293 (includes examples + wording)

docs-bot: docs CI: preview build queued for PR #1293

maria_docs: Quick copy-edit please (we use US English). Also change "Nordics" -> "Nordic" in a couple spots to match style guide.

sam_platform: Suggest small wording tweak: replace "regional capacity" with "regional availability" to avoid implying reserved capacity.

emma_legal: LGTM after those tweaks. Legal fine with short, high-level language.

juan_l10n: Tweaks pushed to PR. CI passed: docs-bot: preview build success \u2705

maria_docs: Merged to staging and promoted to preview site. Leaving a TODO in the PR for audit-log capture of routing decisions (tracked in infra backlog).

sam_platform: Noted — we'll add the audit flag next sprint; no immediate doc updates needed.

maria_docs: Thanks all. Closing the thread; shout if anything reads off in production.
